script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Psychological
Theme: career transition

Begin screenplay.

INT. ART GALLERY - NIGHT

Sophia, a successful BUSINESSWOMAN in her late thirties,
stands before a painting, lost in thought. Her eyes
fill with tears.

Sophia (V.O): I've made a good life for myself. I've
climbed the corporate ladder. But something is missing.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

Sophia sits at a table, reading a book on painting.
Across the room, ANNA, an ARTIST in her early thirties,
paints a landscape.

Anna finishes her painting and looks up, noticing
Sophia watching her. They make eye contact.

Anna: (smiling) Hi. I couldn't help but notice you
watching me.

SOPHIA: (surprised) Hi. I'm Sophia. I've been admiring
your work from afar.

ANNA: (pleasantly) Thank you. I'm Anna.

Sophia: (hesitant) I'm a businesswoman. I've never
really had time for art. But I feel like I'm missing
something.

ANNA: (encouraging) It's never too late to start.
What brings you here today?

SOPHIA: (sighs) I've been feeling disconnected from
my career. I've achieved so much, but it doesn't seem
to fulfill me anymore.

ANNA: (nods) Art has a way of filling the emptiest
spaces. Why don't you try it?

INT. ART CLASSROOM - DAY

Sophia sits in the front row of an art class, holding
her paintbrush tentatively. Anna stands behind her,
observing.

Anna: (encouraging) Just relax and let the colors
flow. Don't think about the end result.

Sophia begins to paint, her brush moving across the
canvas with newfound ease.

INT. ART GALLERY - NIGHT

Sophia stands before her completed painting, tears
streaming down her face.

Sophia (V.O): I've never felt so alive. This is what I
needed. I'm going to transition my career to art.

INT. ANNA'S STUDIO - DAY

Sophia and Anna work together on a large-scale mural
for a local community center.

Anna: (proudly) I'm so happy for you. This is just
the beginning.

Sophia: (determined) I'm ready for the journey.

INT. BUSINESS OFFICE - DAY

Sophia submits her resignation letter to her boss.

BOSS: (surprised) You're leaving? But you're one of our
best performers.

Sophia: (smiling) I've found something that fulfills me
more than my career ever could. I'm following my
dream.

BOSS: (pensive) I wish you all the best.

INT. ART GALLERY OPENING - NIGHT

Sophia's artwork is displayed proudly in a gallery
opening. Friends, family, and colleagues gather to
celebrate her new career.

Sophia: (grateful) I couldn't have done this without
Anna's encouragement.

Anna: (proud) You were the one with the talent all
along. I just helped you see it.

Sophia: (smiling) Thank you. I'm ready for whatever
comes next.

Fade to black.

End screenplay.
